purpose: retrospective risk-forecast diagnostic, not alpha or trading
refit: monthly expanding, labels must end strictly before first forecast-origin date
features: log past market mean-square returns; augmented adds mean of all 45 industry-pair Pearson correlations
target: 252 * mean(next 5 daily market returns squared), not intraday realized variance
forecast_clock: synthetic 23:59 UTC on origin date, uses returns dated through that date; NOT certified vendor availability
market_return: French daily Mkt-RF plus RF, divided by 100; not SPY
industry_returns: French 10 daily value-weighted portfolios, divided by 100
target_transform: natural logarithm; exponentiate predictions without residual correction
standardization: training-only mean and population standard deviation for each monthly fit
secondary_metric: MAE of annualized square-root variance, percentage points
alarm_threshold: 90th percentile of matured training target variance, recomputed at monthly fit
downside_diagnostic: share of next-five-session market losses <= -5% preceded by an alarm; not a separately trained downside forecast
rebound_diagnostic: alarm origins followed by positive five-session market returns; NOT strategy PnL or missed-profit estimate
uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap, 20 adjacent forecast origins; descriptive within this historical episode, not independent-crisis inference
candidate_screen: mean QLIKE improvement >= 5%, paired 95% interval upper bound < 0, and improvement in at least 2 calendar years
missing_policy: preserve union of source session dates; no forward fill or compressed windows; identical complete-case sample for all models
vintage: latest retrospectively reconstructed academic series, not original point-in-time observations
